b: Our Truth & Movies podcast is back, and now it’s in three dimensions. Our latest episode – Fielder Studies – is a celebration of all things Nathan Fielder.

In this episode, Leila Latif, Hannah Strong and David Jenkins look back to the Canadian icon’s roots as an elite cringe comic on shows such as Nathan For You, his graduation to high concept comedy stunt shows like The Rehearsal, and then the original, darkly-comic dramatic series The Curse, in which he acts opposite Emma Stone. And finally, we review the new documentary he made with Lance Oppenheimer, You Can See Everything, in which he becomes a lodger for Elizabeth Holmes and her deeply strange husband.
